goal: Choose one episode and prepare a short, reviewed newsletter draft.

sources.title: Example editorial notes (fictional)
sources.text: Our example team selects one useful lesson from each episode. The producer checks the transcript before turning that lesson into a newsletter. Every excerpt is reviewed against the recording before publication.

sources.title: Example house style
sources.text: Use clear language and short paragraphs. Credit the guest when using their ideas. End with one practical action the reader can try.
